/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
import re, subprocess, sys

html = Path('index.html').read_text()
class Check(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.titles=[]; self.h1=[]; self.canvas=0; self.scripts=[]; self.current=None
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        attrs=dict(attrs)
        if tag in ('title','h1'): self.current=tag
        if tag=='canvas': self.canvas+=1
        if tag=='script' and attrs.get('type')=='module': self.current='module'
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if self.current == tag: self.current=None
        if tag=='script' and self.current=='module': self.current=None
    def handle_data(self, data):
        if self.current=='title': self.titles.append(data.strip())
        elif self.current=='h1': self.h1.append(data.strip())
        elif self.current=='module': self.scripts.append(data)
p=Check(); p.feed(html); p.close()
assert html.startswith('<"'!DOCTYPE html>'"') and html.rstrip().endswith('</html>'), 'document boundary mismatch'
assert p.titles==['EMBER'] and p.h1==['EMBER'], (p.titles,p.h1)
assert p.canvas==1, f'expected one scene canvas, got {p.canvas}'
modules=re.findall(r'<script type=\"module\">(.*?)</script>', html, re.S)
assert len(modules)==1, f'expected one inline module, got {len(modules)}'
assert 'three@0.170.0' in modules[0], 'Three.js CDN is not pinned'
result=subprocess.run(['node','--input-type=module','--check'], input=modules[0], text=True, capture_output=True)
if result.returncode:
    sys.stderr.write(result.stderr); raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
print('HTML structure, title/brand, canvas, pinned CDN, and inline JavaScript syntax: OK')
PY"
